info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About List Files API

params.name: product
params.description: any product subscribed by client. Minimum value for prod code=9001

params.name: start_date
params.description: YYYYMMDD (Choose between 1 and 4 previous trading days)

params.name: end_date
params.description: YYYYMMDD (Choose between 1 and 4 previous trading days, greater than or equal to start date)

params.name: access
params.description: Option to select from static, DL or RT data

items.docs: A service that provides access to Real Time or Delayed data snapped at hourly intervals for an entire Exchange

params.name: schema
params.description:
schema name

**Example: acta_v1, fgp_v1, yn_v1** QFL:- To query QFL data, please use value: **qfl_v1**

params.name: bundle
params.description:
bundle name

If this parameter is not passed in the request, all the bundles a client is subscribed to are returned. QFL:- - For QFL its the factor group name - If this parameter is not passed in the request, all the the factor families & factor groups subscribed to by the user are returned. - Supports comma separated list of multiple factor groups

params.name: type
params.description:
file type = Full or Delta

Full files are weekly files generated every weekend (Saturday). **The date range should include weekend dates if requesting for "Full" files** QFL:- In case of QFL we have - Historical files (1995 to previous year)- Always "Full" . A "Full" file is generated for each year - For YTD (Current year)- "Full" files are weekly files generated every weekend (Saturday). The date range should include weekend dates if requesting for "Full" files

params.name: startDate
params.description:
The earliest date of the feed file the API should fetch for based on the fileTimestamp.

- If schema parameter is not specified in the request, then data requested should be in batches of 10days or less**(Date range should be less than or equal to 10)** - If the schema parameter is specified in the request, date range can be greater than 10 days - If startDate and endDate parameters are not specified in the request, this endpoint returns past 10 days data by default. - startDate can be absolute- YYYY-MM-DD or relative:- -1 for yesterday QFL:- In case of QFL - Historical files available from 1995-01-01 to 2021-12-31. YTD files are current year files.

params.name: endDate
params.description:
The latest date of the feed file the API should fetch for based on the fileTimestamp

If startDate and endDate parameters are not specified in the request, this endpoint returns past 10 days data by default.

endDate can be in absolute- YYYY-MM-DD or relative date:- 0 for today

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the number of results to return per page. Default is 20 & Maximum is 500 results per page

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used

items.docs: List-Files end point provides the delta & full files in a reverse chronological order by default for all the schemas & bundles subscribed by the client QFL:- - In case of QFL, List-Files end point provides the "Historical & Year to Date (YTD)" data in a reverse chronological order by default for all the factor families & groups subscribed to by the user<
